pins.name: TRIG/TX
pins.notes: With the jumper on: UART TX of the ESP32 goes here. Jumper off: trigger input

pins.name: ECHO/RX
pins.notes: With the jumper on: UART, connect to ESP32 RX. Jumper off: echo output

pins.name: GND2
pins.notes: Second ground pin, same as GND

sources.title: US-100 ultrasonic module manual
sources.section: Jumper selects UART (9600 baud) or trigger/echo mode; supply 2.4 to 5.5 V
